packages.name: Hub Inspector
packages.description: A diagnostics dashboard that runs on your hub: resources, app and device CPU use, configuration snapshots you can compare, device usage, and Zigbee, Z-Wave and Matter activity.

packages.name: Log Monitor
packages.description: Watches hub logs, on this hub and others, and sends matching lines to notification devices, a File Manager log file or an HTTP endpoint.

packages.name: ThirdReality Zigbee Drivers
packages.description: Community Hubitat drivers for ThirdReality Zigbee devices — plugs, sensors, and lighting, with full power/energy metering where applicable.

packages.name: Xfinity / Visonic / UEI Contact Sensor
packages.description: Driver for Universal Electronics / Visonic / Xfinity Zigbee contact sensors — contact, temperature, tamper, and battery with configurable reporting intervals.

packages.name: Aqara Drivers
packages.description: Zigbee drivers for Aqara devices; pick the ones you need: WSDCGQ11LM temperature, humidity and pressure sensor, MCCGQ11LM door/window sensor, WS-USC01 no-neutral wall switch.

packages.name: IKEA Window Blinds
packages.description: Zigbee driver for IKEA window blinds (FYRTUR / KADRILJ family).

packages.name: Android TV Remote
packages.description: Google TV / Android TV control over the LAN with no bridge (beta), with an optional tester app.

packages.name: Samsung TV Remote (hubitrep)
packages.description: Samsung Tizen TVs (2016 and later) over the LAN (beta): power, keys, apps, presets, Frame art mode and optional SmartThings, with an optional tester app. Based on Dave Gutheinz's driver.
